denominator_rule: none; referenced tree objects whose retained long-tree record reports an unavailable blob size

params.scope: HEAD tree records in the retained snapshot

confounders: a missing blob size does not identify why retrieval failed
malformed tree records remain unavailable rather than counted as missing objects
the metric covers the recorded tree, not every historical object
status_note: counts explicit '-' blob-size records from retained git ls-tree -l evidence; partial observations keep the count and state visible
